reuse.why: Selects categories with the existing getAverageCategories (which applies shouldFillCategory) and converts the sign with averageToBudgetAmount, the same helpers the average actions use.

duplication.why: No eligibility or sign logic is repeated; the loop body mirrors the sibling actions only in the unavoidable setBudget call.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts beside the other month-wide actions and is registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like its siblings.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Small and consistent; reusing averageToBudgetAmount and getAverageCategories for a non-average action stretches their names slightly.
